plate-2-jetpack.svg: II · jetpack — parallel gzip on JDK 25, drawn as the SIMD bus fanning into four deflate blocks stitched back to one gzip member: 422 against 66.2 MB per second single-threaded, 6.4 times, on an M1 Pro from a 3-fork JMH run. The against-self result is printed on the plate: the JDK's own Adler-32 intrinsic does 14.06 GB per second and is not beaten; the hand-vectorised checksum reaches 4.26, bit-identical to java.util.zip.
